sql_calls.sql:
SELECT sku, gtin, name, pack, case_units, case_kg, flow, dc_slot, price_inr, cost_inr
FROM store.products
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%atta%' OR lower(pack) LIKE '%5 kg%'
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS src, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(date)::text AS first_date, MAX(date)::text AS last_date, SUM(units_sold) AS units, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue
FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', COUNT(*), MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, NULL, NULL FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', COUNT(*), MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, NULL, NULL FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', COUNT(*), MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, SUM(units), NULL FROM store.write_offs WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG';

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS metric, COUNT(*)::text AS n, MIN(bill_ts)::text AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts)::text AS last_ts, SUM(qty)::text AS value1, SUM(line_amount)::text AS value2
FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', COUNT(*)::text, MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf')::text,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty')::text
FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', COUNT(*)::text, MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text,
       SUM(adjustment)::text, SUM(counted)::text
FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_orders', COUNT(*)::text, MIN(created_ts)::text, MAX(created_ts)::text,
       SUM(units)::text, SUM(cases)::text
FROM store.store_orders WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG';

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.reorder_point, f.order_up_to,
       f.book_on_hand AS forecast_book, f.on_order, f.ordered_units,
       i.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=d.date AND f.sku=d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date=d.date AND i.sku=d.sku
WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT a.audit_ts, a.status,
       d.units_sold AS units_that_day,
       i.book_on_hand_close,
       f.forecast_units_per_day
FROM store.shelf_audits a
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku=a.sku AND d.date=a.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku=a.sku AND i.date=a.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=a.sku AND f.date=a.audit_ts::date
WHERE a.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY a.audit_ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
     AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_pos_units,
  (SELECT SUM(line_amount) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
     AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_pos_revenue,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
     AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_pos_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
     AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
     AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01') AS bills_with_atta,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_data_through,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_data_through;

SELECT n.shipment_id, n.sscc, n.line, n.order_id, n.sku, n.gtin, n.cases, n.units,
       p.cases AS pallet_cases, p.notice_kg,
       s.arrived_ts, s.slot_start, s.slot_end
FROM warehouse.shipping_notice_lines n
JOIN warehouse.pallets p ON p.sscc=n.sscc AND p.shipment_id=n.shipment_id
JOIN warehouse.shipments s ON s.shipment_id=n.shipment_id
WHERE n.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY n.shipment_id, n.sscc, n.line;

SELECT grn_id, shipment_id, sscc, line, received_ts, asn_sku, asn_units, sku_booked, units_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE received_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND received_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND (asn_sku <> sku_booked OR asn_units <> units_booked)
ORDER BY received_ts, grn_id, line;

SELECT p.sku, p.name,
       COUNT(a.*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status='empty') AS empty_audits,
       MIN(a.audit_ts) AS first_audit, MAX(a.audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=p.sku
GROUP BY p.sku,p.name
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT date, sku, units, reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

WITH empty_audit_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT audit_ts::date AS date
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND status='empty'
    AND audit_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND audit_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day,
       GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0) AS estimated_unmet_units,
       GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0) * p.price_inr AS estimated_lost_revenue_inr
FROM empty_audit_days e
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.date=e.date AND d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=e.date AND f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=d.sku
ORDER BY d.date;
